autoModeRegressionMatrix.note: Existing live fixtures with no AXB_ACTIVATION, so every test wakes the process with its first read. First run: area and list subform failed. The area test waited for 4D to report a started bridge before reading the window; it now reads the window first, as any client. The list subform test held the table element published while its rows load, which the bridge replaces once loaded (as at every form open); it now finds the loaded table. Its data had also been left edited by the aborted runs and was prepared again. No product change was needed for these. A separate product change followed: providers for forms without an area now leave a window whose bridge session is open but whose view has not attached yet.
